snippet.title: バトルアスリーテス　大運動会 (Battle Athletess Daiundoukai) OP movie (SS)
snippet.description:
This is a demonstration video of  Battle Athletess Daiundoukai released by Sega Saturn.
We plan to upload demonstration videos of all Sega Saturn software.
I will do my best to upload one video a day.

When you get used to it, you can make the Sega Saturn game video longer or post the playing video.
Please look forward to it.
